what.text: This page follows refugees from Somalia living in Kenya.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 319471 Somali refugees in Kenya, 35.8% of all Somali refugees and more than in any other host country.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Somalia in several periods since 1982.
From 1986 to 1996 the groups fighting the government include the SNM, the SPM and the USC/SNA; from 2006 to 2025 they include Al-Shabaab and Hizbul Islam, at war level in most years since 2007.

when.text: The main years of displacement in the data are 1992, 2008 to 2017 and 2020 to 2025.
UNHCR's figure for Kenya peaked at 517666 in 2011 and fell to 252498 by 2018.
Returns from Kenya to Somalia were highest in 1993 in UNHCR's returns data.

how.text: These are year-end totals of refugees in Kenya only.
People displaced inside Somalia are counted separately by UNHCR and by IDMC, and their figures are never added.
The sources don't say which routes people took or where in Kenya they live.
